newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to absorb 600 bln won through repos.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to absorb 600 bln won through repos.

text.p: The Bank of Korea said on Wednesday it has decided to absorb 600 billion won from commercial banks through five-day repurchase agreements (repos).
"Because of ample liquidity in the market, we have decided to soak up 600 billion won in circulation," a central bank official told Reuters by telephone.
"The liquidity condition looks good so far for banks and non-banking institutions. Therefore we don't expect any problem with the liquidity squeeze."
